Addons_Help_Text: Each OptiAssist module is a compiled .NET library (.dll) stored in Config\Addons\<ModuleName>\<ModuleName>.dll implementing IOptiAssistAddon. Enabled modules integrate seamlessly into the sidebar navigation as native pages.
Addons_Manager_Subtitle: Add, enable, disable, or remove modular DLL plugins stored in Config\Addons. Active modules appear directly in the sidebar.
Compat_NoQuirks: No known hardware or driver quirks (out of 13 documented scenarios) were detected on this machine.
Compat_Quirks_Title: Detected Hardware Quirks & Known Driver Issues
Dashboard_CommonTasks_Empty: No common tasks configured. Click 'Customize' to add or restore default tasks.
Dashboard_CustomizeTasks_Desc: Manage, add, reorder or remove shortcuts and actions shown in Common Tasks.
Debloat_ActivityHistory_Desc: Sets EnableActivityFeed=0, PublishUserActivities=0, and UploadUserActivities=0 under Policies\\Microsoft\\Windows\\System.
Debloat_ActivityHistory_Title: Disable Activity History & Cloud Timeline Sync
Debloat_AppBloatAppx_Desc: Selectively uninstalls BingNews, BingWeather, Solitaire, Clipchamp, OfficeHub, Todos, PowerAutomate, FeedbackHub, and DevHome while keeping Microsoft Store, Xbox/Gaming Services, and media codecs intact.
Debloat_AppBloatAppx_Title: Remove Pre-Installed Consumer AppX Bloatware (Preserves Store, Xbox & Codecs)
Debloat_AppDisableNewOutlook_Desc: Sets UseNewOutlook=0 and HideNewOutlookToggle=1 across active and default users to prevent Classic Outlook from being replaced by the WebView2 app.
Debloat_AppLogiLda_Desc: Removes LogiLDA startup injection when Logitech USB peripherals (VID_046D) are detected.
Debloat_AppOneDriveSafe_Desc: Uninstalls OneDrive only when objective safety criteria pass: Windows InstallDate < 14 days, 0 configured OneDrive accounts, and empty %UserProfile%\\OneDrive folder.
Debloat_AppOneDriveSafe_Title: Remove Microsoft OneDrive (Protected by 3-Point Safety Check)
Debloat_AppSafeTempCleanup_Desc: Safely cleans User/Windows Temp folders via OptiAssist's native backup-backed cleaner engine (quarantined in Config\\Addons\\SystemCleaner\\backups) without using cleanmgr.exe.
Debloat_AppSafeTempCleanup_Title: Safe Temporary Files Cleanup (System Cleaner Engine with Quarantine Backup)
Debloat_BgApps_Desc: Sets AppPrivacy\\LetAppsRunInBackground=2 (Force Deny) to stop idle UWP apps from waking CPU/RAM in the background.
Debloat_BingSearch_Desc: Applies DisableWebSearch=1, AllowCortana=0, EnableDynamicContentInWSB=0, and DisableSearchBoxSuggestions=1 for fast local-only Start Menu search.
Debloat_BingSearch_Title: Disable Bing Web Search, Search Highlights & Cortana (Search.admx)
Debloat_Brave_Desc: Applies official Brave GPO policies (only when Brave is installed) to disable Rewards, Wallet, Leo AI, and VPN prompts.
Debloat_Brave_Title: Debloat Brave Browser (Rewards, Wallet, Leo AI & VPN)
Debloat_BrowserPolicy_ConfirmPrompt:
Browser Enterprise Policy Notice

Applying debloat policies to {0} writes corporate policy keys under HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies. As a result, the browser menu will show 'Managed by your organization'.

Do you want to continue?
Debloat_CapExtWallpapers_Desc: Removes optional Extended Theme/Wallpaper Content capability via wildcard matching.
Debloat_CapHelloFace_Desc: Removes Hello.Face capability when no Infrared camera is detected. Opt-in on laptops.
Debloat_CapHelloFace_Title: Uninstall Windows Hello Facial Recognition (No IR Camera)
Debloat_CapMathRecognizer_Desc: Removes MathRecognizer optional capability dynamically via wildcard matching.
Debloat_CapVbscript_Desc: Dynamically matches and removes the deprecated VBSCRIPT capability via Get-WindowsCapability without hardcoded version suffixes.
Debloat_ConsumerFeatures_Desc: Prevents automatic installation of sponsored apps via CloudContent policies and disables ContentDeliveryManager suggestions for active and default users.
Debloat_DoubleConfirm_Step2:
FINAL CONFIRMATION (2/2)

Are you completely sure you want to apply '{0}'?
This action may be irreversible or long-running.
Debloat_Edge_Desc: Applies official Microsoft Edge GPO policies (only when Edge is installed). Shows 'Managed by your organization' in Edge settings.
Debloat_Edge_Title: Debloat Microsoft Edge (Telemetry, Sidebar, Shopping & Startup Boost)
Debloat_FeatPrintingStack_Desc: Disables Printing-PrintToPDFServices-Features, Printing-XPSServices-Features, and Printing-Foundation-Features following the Spooler profile rule.
Debloat_FeatPrintingStack_Title: Disable Printing Optional Features (Print to PDF, XPS, Foundation)
Debloat_FeatSmbDirect_Desc: Disables SmbDirect (used only on enterprise RDMA NICs) on consumer/gaming/laptop PCs.
Debloat_FeatWorkFolders_Desc: Disables the enterprise WorkFolders-Client Windows optional feature via DISM.
Debloat_FeatWorkFolders_Title: Disable Work Folders Client Optional Feature
Debloat_PolDeliveryOpt_Desc: Sets DODownloadMode=0 (HTTP only, no peer-to-peer uploads) to avoid background bandwidth spikes while gaming or on metered connections.
Debloat_PolLocMapsHome_Desc: Applies LocationProviderAdm.admx (DisableWindowsLocationProvider=1 on desktops), WinMaps.admx (AutoDownloadAndUpdateMapData=0), and legacy HomeGroup policy.
Debloat_PolLocMapsHome_Title: Disable Location Provider, Offline Maps Auto-Update & HomeGroup
Debloat_PolStoreAutoDownload_Desc: Sets WindowsStore\\AutoDownload=2 to stop background Store downloads. Pre-selected (with Dry-Run warning) in Gaming, Hybrid, and Ultraportable; opt-in in others.
Debloat_PolStoreAutoDownload_Title: Disable Microsoft Store Automatic App Updates (WindowsStore.admx)
Debloat_PwrEnergySaverOff_Desc: Ensures Windows Energy Saver threshold is disabled (0%) on desktop machines.
Debloat_PwrEnergySaverOff_Title: Disable Energy Saver on Desktop PCs
Debloat_PwrHibernateOff_Desc: Runs powercfg /h off on desktops and ultraportables to reclaim gigabytes of SSD/eMMC space and avoid Fast Startup kernel issues. Never enabled on standard/gaming laptops.
Debloat_PwrHybridPlan_Desc: Clones the Windows Balanced plan (without overwriting it) with DISKIDLE=0, Wi-Fi Max Performance, CPU 5%-100%, AC timeouts (20m screen / never sleep/hibernate) and DC timeouts (10m / 30m / 1h).
Debloat_PwrMouseAccelOff_Desc: Sets MouseSpeed=0, MouseThreshold1=0, and MouseThreshold2=0 across active and default users for consistent 1:1 aiming in games.
Debloat_PwrMouseAccelOff_Title: Disable Mouse Acceleration (1:1 Raw Linear Curve)
Debloat_PwrOverlayPerf_Desc: Activates the native Best Performance power overlay (ded574b5-45a0-4f42-8737-46345c09c238) while plugged in.
Debloat_PwrOverlayPerf_Title: Set Windows Power Mode to Best Performance (AC)
Debloat_PwrUsbPcieMobile_Desc: Configures USB Selective Suspend (Enabled) and PCIe Link State Power Management (Moderate) to maximize battery autonomy on laptops and ultraportables.
Debloat_PwrUsbPcieMobile_Title: Enable USB Selective Suspend & Moderate PCIe Power Savings (Mobile)
Debloat_PwrUsbPciePerf_Desc: Sets USB Selective Suspend and PCIe ASPM to Disabled (0) to eliminate latency spikes on NVMe, GPUs, gaming peripherals, and remote desktop sessions.
Debloat_PwrUsbPciePerf_Title: Disable USB Selective Suspend & PCIe Link State Power Management
Debloat_SecBitLockerPreventAuto_Desc: Sets BitLocker\\PreventDeviceEncryption=1 on desktops and ultraportables to prevent silent automatic encryption. Never enabled on standard laptops and never runs manage-bde -off.
Debloat_SecBitLockerPreventAuto_Title: Prevent Automatic BitLocker Device Encryption (Desktops & Ultraportable)
Debloat_SecDefenderBestEffort_Desc: Applies WindowsDefender.admx policies: AvgCPULoadFactor=5, LowCpuPriority=1, disables catch-up scans, and sets SpynetReporting=0 / SubmitSamplesConsent=2 when Tamper Protection allows.
Debloat_SecDefenderBestEffort_Title: Tune Windows Defender CPU Throttling & Cloud Samples (Best Effort)
Debloat_SecHvci_Desc: Sets HypervisorEnforcedCodeIntegrity\\Enabled=0 to eliminate VBS/HVCI overhead in games. Requires reboot. Never modifies Secure Boot or TPM.
Debloat_SecHvci_Title: Disable Memory Integrity (HVCI) for Maximum Gaming FPS
Debloat_SecKernelShadow_Desc: Sets KernelShadowStacks\\Enabled=0 (Win11 22H2+) to resolve legacy anti-cheat incompatibilities and reduce kernel overhead. Reboot required.
Debloat_SecSmartAppControl_Desc: Sets CI\\Policy\\VerifiedAndReputablePolicyState=0. Always opt-in across all profiles. Once disabled, Smart App Control CANNOT be re-enabled without a full Windows reset/reinstall.
Debloat_SecSmartAppControl_Title: Disable Smart App Control [Irreversible — Double Confirmation]
Debloat_SvcDiagTrackWer_Desc: Stops and disables Connected User Experiences and Telemetry (DiagTrack) and Windows Error Reporting (WerSvc) across all profiles.
Debloat_SvcDiagTrackWer_Title: Disable Telemetry & Error Reporting Services (DiagTrack & WerSvc)
Debloat_SvcLfsvc_Desc: Stops and disables the Geolocation Service on desktop PCs. Automatically hidden on laptops to preserve automatic timezone and Find My Device.
Debloat_SvcSpooler_Desc: Disables Print Spooler in Gaming, Hybrid, and Gaming Laptop profiles. Opt-in only on Workstation, Laptop, Conventional Desktop, and Ultraportable.
Debloat_SvcSysMainSsd_Desc: Disables SysMain background preloading only when the system drive is confirmed to be SSD/NVMe. Automatically blocked on mechanical HDDs and eMMC.
Debloat_SvcThemes_Desc: Advanced opt-in tweak that stops the Windows Themes service to save minimal RAM on legacy/ultraportable hardware. May alter classic Win32 UI rendering.
Debloat_SvcTrkWks_Desc: Disables TrkWks background NTFS link tracking on optimized standalone PCs.
Debloat_SvcWSearch_Desc: Disables background file indexing in Gaming, Hybrid, and Ultraportable profiles. Kept intact on Workstation, Laptop, and Conventional Desktop.
Debloat_Telemetry_Desc: Sets edition-aware AllowTelemetry (0 on Enterprise/IoT, 1 on Pro/Home), disables Advertising ID, feedback notifications, and Windows Error Reporting (Disabled=1).
Debloat_UiCompactOs_Desc: Runs compact.exe /CompactOS:always to reclaim ~2-4 GB on small drives. Requires SSE4.2, < 15 GB free space, and explicit confirmation.
Debloat_UiCompactOs_Title: Enable CompactOS Compression (SSE4.2 & Free Space < 15 GB)
Debloat_UiDesktopIcons_Desc: Enables standard desktop icons under HideDesktopIcons\\NewStartPanel for active and default users.
Debloat_UiDesktopIcons_Title: Show Classic Desktop Icons (This PC, User Files, Network, Recycle Bin, Control Panel)
Debloat_UiDynamicLightingOff_Desc: Turns off Windows Dynamic Lighting background polling (AmbientLightingEnabled=0). Opt-in on Gaming Laptops.
Debloat_UiLockScreenClean_Desc: Blocks Spotlight tips/overlays and sets DisableWidgetsOnLockScreen=1 (NewsAndInterests.admx).
Debloat_UiLockScreenClean_Title: Disable Lock Screen Tips, Fun Facts & Widgets
Debloat_UiRemoteAssistOff_Desc: Sets fAllowToGetHelp=0 (RemoteAssistance.admx) to disable unsolicited remote assistance connections.
Debloat_UiReservedStorageOff_Desc: Runs DISM /Online /Set-ReservedStorageState /State:Disabled (Build >= 18362) to reclaim space on constrained eMMC/SSD drives.
Debloat_UiSchedulerBg_Desc: Applies fixed equal quantum (0x18) for Workstation and Hybrid profiles (opt-in in Gaming). Gaming, Laptop, Ultraportable, and Conventional Desktop keep Windows default (Programs).
Debloat_UiTaskbarEndTask_Desc: Sets TaskbarEndTask=1 under TaskbarDeveloperSettings so frozen apps can be killed directly from the taskbar context menu.
Debloat_UiTaskbarEndTask_Title: Enable 'End Task' in Taskbar Right-Click Menu (Win11 23H2+)
Debloat_UiTransparency_Desc: Sets EnableTransparency=0 automatically when CPU/BIOS year < 2019, problematic iGPU (HD 2000/2500/3000, GMA, nForce) is detected, or Ultraportable profile is active. Kept On above 2019.
Debloat_UiTransparency_Title: Disable Transparency Effects (Hardware < 2019 / Legacy iGPU / Ultraportable)
Debloat_UiVisualEffects_Desc: Disables non-essential animations via SystemParametersInfo (Menu, ComboBox, ListBox, SelectionFade, Tooltip, MenuFade, CursorShadow, DropShadow), TaskbarAnimations=0 and EnableAeroPeek=0.
Debloat_UiWin7PhotoViewer_Desc: Registers PhotoViewer.FileAssoc.Tiff for .jpg, .jpeg, .png, .bmp, and .gif to replace the heavy UWP Photos app on low-RAM ultraportables.
Debloat_UiWin7PhotoViewer_Title: Restore Classic Windows 7 Photo Viewer Associations (Ultraportable)
Debloat_Widgets_Desc: Applies Dsh\\AllowNewsAndInterests=0, DisableWidgetsBoard=1, and removes WebExperience packages to free RAM.
Debloat_Widgets_Title: Disable Taskbar Widgets & News and Interests (NewsAndInterests.admx)
Debloat_WindowsAI_Desc: Blocks Recall (DisableAIDataAnalysis=1, AllowRecallEnablement=0), Click to Do, Copilot, and merges 'aicomponents' into SettingsPageVisibility non-destructively.
Debloat_WindowsAI_Title: Disable Windows AI, Recall Snapshots, Click to Do & Copilot
Debloat_Wpbt_Desc: Sets DisableWpbtExecution=1 to block OEM binaries injected via ACPI WPBT table at boot. Caution on OEM laptops using legitimate firmware tools.

Rec_DualChannel_Desc: Detected 8 GB of RAM operating in single-channel mode (1 slot populated). Installing a matching second RAM module enables Dual Channel, providing up to 15-25% higher memory bandwidth for integrated graphics and multitasking.
Rec_Hdd_Desc: Windows is operating on a mechanical hard drive (HDD). Replacing it with a solid-state drive (SSD SATA or NVMe) will provide up to 5x-10x faster boot times and eliminate system latency.
Rec_Hdd_Title: Upgrade Mechanical Hard Drive to SSD
Rec_RamLow_Win10Desc: This PC has 4 GB of RAM installed. While Windows 10 functions, running multiple applications concurrently will cause memory bottlenecks. Adding more RAM will noticeably improve responsiveness.
Rec_RamLow_Win11Desc: This system is running Windows 11 with 4 GB of RAM (minimum requirement). Modern workloads and browser tabs will experience page-file throttling. Upgrading to at least 8 GB or 16 GB is strongly advised.
Rec_SecureBoot_Desc: Secure Boot is currently disabled. Enabling it in your UEFI BIOS firmware protects against bootkits and fulfills official Windows 11 platform security standards.

Welcome_Notice_Text: OptiAssist is a powerful toolkit designed for IT professionals and power users that performs deep system administrative operations (including system integrity checks, DISM/SFC repairs, system cleaning, and startup adjustments). Administrative commands modify low-level Windows settings. Ensure you review and understand actions prior to executing them.
